releaseNotes:
SecApper Live Update v1.1.4:
• Windows 11 File Explorer Support: Added top-level window enumeration to detect background and unfocused TaskDialogs in Windows 11 File Explorer.
• Native Windows 11 Permission Dialog Interception: Successfully recognizes Windows 11 TaskDialogs (with Continue/Cancel action buttons) matching locked folder names and cleanly dismisses them.
• Standalone Double-Click Unlock Modal: Reliably displays the centered Unlock popup dialog on both Windows 10 and Windows 11 without opening the main application window.
• Jitter-Free Debounce & Fast Re-Lock: Eliminates permanent HWND blacklisting and synchronizes cache invalidation on lock/auto-lock.
